modules.responsibility: The CLI package exposes the app lazily so executable startup can load its environment first.
Executable CLI startup loads the working-directory environment before importing and running the app.
Declares Typer commands and delegates each operation to its CLI adapter.
The adapter reads CLI inputs, validates transport options, and calls authoring services.
The presenter formats run, lint, scaffold, and demo responses and sets CLI error codes.
The CLI commands cover full execution, system information, project initialization, and demo management.
The helpers list demo names for autocomplete and copy a selected packaged demo into the working directory.
The MCP package exposes server entrypoints lazily without initializing the application graph.
The MCP executable loads the working-directory environment, then selects transport and bind configuration.
The server adapts the same authoring calls asynchronously and can protect SSE access with an API key.
Project initialization writes directories, a README, and a fixed embedded XML model.
DataMimicTest wraps a RunSession and permits result capture only when test mode is explicitly enabled.
DataMimic translates Python parameters into RunRequest and retains the session for execute and capture.
The factory starts a test-configured RunSession and returns individual or batched generated entities.

rules.rationale: Every child implementation has one owner; parent initializer behavior is reviewed explicitly.
Only the listed responsibility directions are permitted.
A dependency reaches explicit operations and types, not arbitrary implementation details.
Lower layers do not import their consumers.
